label: Writing a mesh equation
subgoals: Assign a clockwise current to each mesh
Sum the resistor drops around the mesh in the current direction
Equate the drops to the net source rise and solve

label: Solving two meshes
subgoals: Put each mesh's total resistance on the diagonal
Put minus the shared resistance off the diagonal
Solve the two-by-two system for both mesh currents

label: Branch currents from mesh currents
subgoals: Identify which meshes border the branch
Subtract the neighbouring mesh current from the reference mesh current
Read the sign as the direction of the branch current
